# `/certification-tasks` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /certification-tasks/v1/{id}

`getCertificationTaskV1` — Certification task by id

This API returns the certification task for the specified ID. Reviewers for the specified certification can also call this API.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The task ID
- Returns 200: certificationtask

### GET /certification-tasks/v1

`getPendingCertificationTasksV1` — List of pending certification tasks

This API returns a list of pending (`QUEUED` or `IN_PROGRESS`) certification tasks. Any authenticated token can call this API, but only certification tasks you are authorized to review will be returned.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:read
- Parameters:
  - `reviewer-identity` (query) — The ID of reviewer identity. *me* indicates the current user.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; targetId: eq, in; type: eq, in — e.g. `type eq "ADMIN_REASSIGN"`
- Returns 200: array of certificationtask
